## ❓ Support Request

> **Before submitting a support request**, please make sure you have:
> - Searched [existing issues](https://github.com/MuradoffTehmez/Collabix/issues?q=is%3Aissue) for similar questions
> - Reviewed the [project documentation / README](https://github.com/MuradoffTehmez/Collabix#readme)
> - Checked the [Discussions](https://github.com/MuradoffTehmez/Collabix/discussions) tab for community answers
>
> This helps us avoid duplicate requests and speeds up resolution time.

---

### 📌 Request Type

<!-- Select the category that best describes your request (put an "x" inside the brackets). -->

- [ ] 🔧 Configuration / Setup Help
- [ ] 📖 Usage / How-To Question
- [ ] 🔗 Integration / Third-Party Compatibility
- [ ] 🚀 Deployment / Hosting Issue
- [ ] 🔐 Authentication / Permissions
- [ ] 📦 Dependency / Installation Problem
- [ ] 📊 Performance / Optimization
- [ ] 🧩 API / SDK Usage
- [ ] ❓ General Question
- [ ] 💡 Other (please specify below)

---

### 📝 Description

<!-- 
  Provide a clear and detailed description of what you need help with.
  Include:
  - What feature or area of Collabix is involved?
  - When did this issue start?
  - Is this blocking your workflow?
-->



### 🎯 Expected Goal / Desired Outcome

<!-- 
  Describe what you are trying to achieve in detail.
  - What is the end result you expect?
  - Have you seen this working before in a different version or environment?
  - Is there any reference documentation or example you are following?
-->



### ⚠️ Current Behavior / Issue

<!-- 
  Describe what is currently happening instead of the expected behavior.
  - Is it an error, unexpected output, or missing functionality?
  - Is it consistent (happens every time) or intermittent?
  - Did this previously work and stopped after an update or config change?
-->



### 🧪 What Have You Already Tried?

<!-- 
  List any troubleshooting steps you've already taken.
  This helps us avoid suggesting things you've already done.
-->

- [ ] Cleared cache / reinstalled dependencies
- [ ] Restarted the development server
- [ ] Tested in a different browser / environment
- [ ] Checked the console / terminal for error messages
- [ ] Reviewed relevant documentation
- [ ] Searched existing GitHub Issues & Discussions
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### 🖥️ Context & Environment

<!-- Fill in all applicable fields. This helps us reproduce and diagnose your issue faster. -->

| Field                    | Value                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Collabix Version**     | <!-- e.g. v0.1.0-alpha, v1.2.3 -->                          |
| **OS / Platform**        | <!-- e.g. Windows 11 23H2, macOS 15 Sequoia, Ubuntu 24.04 --> |
| **Browser & Version**    | <!-- e.g. Chrome 128, Firefox 130, Safari 18 -->             |
| **Node.js Version**      | <!-- e.g. v20.15.0 (run: node -v) -->                       |
| **Package Manager**      | <!-- e.g. npm 10.x, yarn 4.x, pnpm 9.x, bun 1.x -->        |
| **TypeScript Version**   | <!-- e.g. 5.5.x (run: npx tsc -v) -->                       |
| **Framework Version**    | <!-- e.g. Next.js 14.2, React 18.3 -->                      |
| **Deployment Target**    | <!-- e.g. Vercel, Firebase, Docker, Cloudflare, local -->    |
| **Firebase SDK Version** | <!-- e.g. firebase@10.x (if applicable) -->                  |
| **Device Type**          | <!-- e.g. Desktop, Mobile (iPhone 15), Tablet -->            |

### 🏷️ Priority / Urgency

- [ ] 🟢 **Low** — General question, no time pressure

- [ ] 🟠 **High** — Blocking an important feature or workflow
- [ ] 🔴 **Critical** — Production is affected, no workaround available
